title: Integrative systems biology and drug repurposing reveal key regulatory hubs and a prognostic signature in gastric cancer.
authors: Akhavan, Reza; Foroughian, Mahdi; Amerizadeh, Forouzan
one_liner_zh: 该文整合转录组与网络生物学预测胃癌上游转录因子并做分子对接，但TF-DNA互作非核心，方法以常规生信和对接为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟深度建模，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer remains one of the most lethal malignancies worldwide, characterized by extensive molecular heterogeneity, late diagnosis, and limited therapeutic options. Identifying key regulatory genes, upstream transcription factors, and clinically meaningful prognostic markers is essential for improving patient management and accelerating targeted drug discovery. METHODS: We performed an integrative systems biology analysis using microarray data (GSE146996) comprising 50 tumor and 15 normal gastric tissues. After RMA normalization, differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified and used to construct a protein-protein interaction network in STRING, followed by hub-gene prioritization via CytoHubba. Functional annotation was performed using ClueGO (KEGG) and BiNGO (GO). Upstream transcription factors were predicted with iRegulon. To assess clinical relevance, RNA-seq and survival data from the TCGA-STAD cohort were used for univariate Cox regression, Kaplan-Meier analysis, LASSO Cox modeling, and development of a multigene prognostic signature. Finally, network pharmacology, homology modeling, and AutoDock Vina-based molecular docking identified candidate therapeutic compounds targeting key hub proteins. RESULTS: A total of 16,304 DEGs were identified, and a refined gastric-specific PPI network of 1,282 genes revealed FN1, CTNNB1, ACTB, and HSP90AB1 as central hubs. Enrichment analysis emphasized pathways related to PI3K-Akt signaling, focal adhesion, proteoglycans in cancer, and immune regulation. iRegulon identified several transcription factors, including SSX3, ARP1, and RBBP9. Prognostic assessment in TCGA-STAD showed that FN1 and SRSF7 were significantly associated with overall survival. Based on these associations, a simple two-gene Cox-based prognostic model was constructed, showing modest stratification of patients into high- and low-risk groups (log-rank p = 0.047). Docking analysis identified several computationally predicted high-affinity compound-protein interactions, including SNX-5422 for HSP90AB1 (-9.5 kcal/mol), Empesertib and ICG-001 for CTNNB1 ( approximately  - 9.1 kcal/mol), and Pimozide for ACTB (-9.4 kcal/mol). DISCUSSION: Integrating transcriptomic profiling with network biology, transcription factor prediction, survival modeling, and molecular docking highlights a multilayer regulatory architecture underlying gastric cancer progression. The identification of survival-associated genes and druggable hubs provides biologically relevant, hypothesis-generating insights that help bridge basic systems biology with translational oncology. Although the prognostic model demonstrated moderate predictive power, its stability across time points suggests potential utility as a foundation for further refinement and validation. Likewise, the identified compounds warrant experimental exploration to confirm their therapeutic promise. CONCLUSION: This comprehensive pipeline identified key molecular drivers, upstream regulators, survival-associated biomarkers, and potential therapeutic compounds in gastric cancer. The findings offer a robust framework for future experimental validation and contribute to the development of personalized therapeutic strategies for improving clinical outcomes in gastric cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌仍是全球致死率最高的恶性肿瘤之一，其特征包括广泛的分子异质性、诊断延迟和治疗选择有限。识别关键调控基因、上游转录因子及具有临床意义的预后标志物，对于改善患者管理和加速靶向药物研发至关重要。方法：我们利用包含50例肿瘤组织和15例正常胃组织的微阵列数据（GSE146996）进行了整合系统生物学分析。经RMA标准化后，鉴定差异表达基因（DEGs），并用于在STRING中构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，随后通过CytoHubba进行核心基因优先排序。功能注释使用ClueGO（KEGG）和BiNGO（GO）完成。上游转录因子通过iRegulon预测。为评估临床相关性，使用TCGA-STAD队列的RNA-seq和生存数据进行单变量Cox回归、Kaplan-Meier分析、LASSO Cox建模，并开发多基因预后特征。最后，通过网络药理学、同源建模和基于AutoDock Vina的分子对接，识别靶向关键核心蛋白的候选治疗化合物。结果：共鉴定出16,304个DEGs，构建的胃特异性PPI网络包含1,282个基因，其中FN1、CTNNB1、ACTB和HSP90AB1被确认为核心枢纽。富集分析强调了与PI3K-Akt信号通路、黏着斑、癌症中的蛋白聚糖及免疫调节相关的通路。iRegulon识别了多个转录因子，包括SSX3、ARP1和RBBP9。TCGA-STAD中的预后评估显示，FN1和SRSF7与总生存期显著相关。基于这些关联，构建了一个简单的双基因Cox预后模型，将患者分为高风险和低风险组，分层效果中等（log-rank p = 0.047）。对接分析识别了几种计算预测的高亲和力化合物-蛋白质相互作用，包括SNX-5422与HSP90AB1（-9.5 kcal/mol）、Empesertib和ICG-001与CTNNB1（约-9.1 kcal/mol），以及Pimozide与ACTB（-9.4 kcal/mol）。讨论：将转录组谱分析与网络生物学、转录因子预测、生存建模和分子对接相结合，揭示了胃癌进展背后的多层调控架构。生存相关基因和可成药核心的识别提供了具有生物学相关性和假设生成性的见解，有助于弥合基础系统生物学与转化肿瘤学之间的鸿沟。尽管预后模型显示出中等预测能力，但其在不同时间点的稳定性表明，作为进一步优化和验证的基础具有潜在价值。同样，所识别的化合物值得实验探索以确认其治疗前景。结论：这一综合流程识别了胃癌中的关键分子驱动因素、上游调控因子、生存相关生物标志物和潜在治疗化合物。研究结果为未来实验验证提供了稳健框架，并有助于开发个性化治疗策略，以改善胃癌的临床结局。
